text: arasaṃ prācyaṃ viṣam arasaṃ yad udīcyam | athedam adharācyaṃ karambheṇa vi kalpate ||
karambhaṃ kṛtvā tiryaṃ pīvasphākam udārathim | kṣudhā kila tvā duṣṭano jakṣivāṃsaṃ na rūrupaḥ ||
vi te madaṃ madavati śarum iva pātayāmasi | pra tvā carum iva yeṣantaṃ vacasā sthāpayāmasi ||
pari grāmam ivācitaṃ pari tvā sthāpayāmasi | tiṣṭhā vṛkṣa iva sthāmann abhrikhāte na rūrupaḥ ||
pavastais tvā pary akrīṇan dūrśebhir ajinair uta | prakrīr asi tvam oṣadhe 'bhrikhāte na rūrupaḥ ||
āvidya dyāvāpṛthivī āvidya bhagam aśvinā | āvidya brahmaṇaspatiṃ kṛṇomy arasaṃ viṣam ||
arasaṃ hed idaṃ viṣaṃ yathainad aham āśiṣam | utainad adyāt puruṣo bhavād id agadaḥ punaḥ ||
mā bibher na mariṣyasi pari tvā pāmi viśvataḥ | rasaṃ viṣasya nāvidam udnaḥ phenam adann iva ||
apāvocad apavaktā prathamo daivyo bhiṣak | samakṣam indra gā iva yā vāco viṣadūṣaṇīḥ ||
yac ca piṣṭaṃ yac cāpiṣṭaṃ yad digdhaṃ yac ca dehyam | devāḥ sarvasya vidvāṃso 'rasaṃ kṛṇutā viṣam ||
kṣetriyāt tvā nirṛtyā jāmiśaṃsād druho muñcāmi varuṇasya pāśāt | anāgasaṃ brahmaṇā tvā kṛṇomi śive te dyāvāpṛthivī abhūtām ||
śaṃ te agniḥ sahādbhir astu śaṃ gāvaḥ sahauṣadhībhiḥ | śam antarikṣaṃ sahavātam astu te śaṃ te bhavantu pradiśaś catasraḥ ||
yā devīḥ pradiśaś catasro vātapatnīr abhi sūryo vicaṣṭe | tāsv etaṃ jarasa ā dadhāmi pra yakṣma etu nirṛtiḥ parācaiḥ ||
sūryam ṛtaṃ tamaso grāhyā yathā devā muñcanto asṛjan nir enasaḥ | evā tvā kṣetriyān nirṛtyā jāmiśaṃsād druho muñcāmi varuṇasya pāśāt ||
amoci yakṣmād duritād avadyād druhaḥ pāśād grāhyāś cod amoci | jahad avartim avidat syonām apy abhūd bhadre sukṛtasya loke ||
niḥsālāṃ dhṛṣṇuṃ dhiṣaṇam ekāvādyāṃ jighatsvam | sarvāś caṇḍasya naptyo nāśayāmaḥ sadānvāḥ ||
yadi vā gha kṣetriyād yadi vā puruṣeṣitāḥ | yadi stha dasyubhyo jātā naśyatetaḥ sadānvāḥ ||
pari dhāmāny āsām āśur gāṣṭhām ivāsaram | ajaiṣaṃ sarvām̐ ājīn vo naśyatetaḥ sadānvāḥ ||
nir vo goṣṭhād ajāmasi nir yoner nir upānasāt | nir vo magundyā duhitaro gṛhebhyaś cātayāmasi ||
amuṣminn adhare gṛhe sarvāḥ santv arāyyaḥ | tatra pāpmā ny ucyatu sarvāś ca yātudhānyaḥ ||
dyāvāpṛthivī urv antarikṣaṃ kṣetrasya patny urugāyo adbhutaḥ | utāntarikṣam uru vātagopaṃ te gha tapyantāṃ mayi tapyamāne ||
idam indra śṛṇuhi somapa yat tvā hṛdā śocatā johavīmi | vṛścāmi taṃ kuliśeneva vṛkṣaṃ yo asmākaṃ mana idaṃ hinasti ||
idaṃ devāḥ śṛṇuta ye ca yajñiyā stha bharadvājo mahyam ukthāni śaṃsatu | pāśe sa baddho durite ni yujyatāṃ yo asmākaṃ mana idaṃ hinasti ||
aśītibhis tisṛbhiḥ sāmagebhir ādityebhir vasubhir aṅgirobhiḥ | iṣṭāpūrtam avatu naḥ pitṝṇām āmuṃ dade harasā daivyena ||
dyāvāpṛthivī anu mā dīdhīthāṃ viśve devāso anu mā rabhadhvam | aṅgirasaḥ pitaraḥ somyāsaḥ pāpam ā rcchatv apakāmasya kartā ||
atīva yo maruto manyate no brahma vā yo nindiṣat kriyamāṇam | tapūṃṣi tasmai vṛjināni santu brahmadviṣam abhi taṃ śocatu dyauḥ ||
ā dadhāmi te padaṃ samiddhe jātavedasi | agniḥ śarīraṃ veveṣṭu yamaṃ gacchatu te asuḥ ||
sapta prāṇān aṣṭau majjñas tāṃs te vṛścāmi brahmaṇā | yamasya gaccha sādanam agnidūto araṃkṛtaḥ ||
venas tat paśyat paramaṃ padaṃ yatra viśvaṃ bhavaty ekanīḍam | idaṃ dhenur aduhaj jāyamānāḥ svarvido abhy anūṣata vrāḥ ||
pra tad voced amṛtaṃ na vidvān gandharvo dhāma paramaṃ guhā yat | trīṇi padā nihitā guhāsya yas tāni veda sa pituṣ pitāsat ||
sa no bandhur janitā sa vidhartā dhāmāni veda bhuvanāni viśvā | yatra devā amṛtam ānaśānāḥ samāne dhāmann adhy airayanta ||
pari viśvā bhuvanāny āyam upātiṣṭhe prathamajā ṛtasya | vācam iva vaktari bhuvaneṣṭhā dhāsyur nv eṣa nanv eṣo agniḥ ||
pari dyāvāpṛthivī sadya āyam ṛtasya tantuṃ vitataṃ dṛśe kam | devo devatvam abhirakṣamāṇaḥ samānaṃ bandhuṃ vy apṛcchad ekaḥ ||
indra juṣasvā yāhi śūra pibā sutasya madhoś cakānaḥ | cārur madāya ||
ā tvā viśantu sutāsa indra pṛṇasva kukṣī viḍḍhi śakra | dhiyehy ā naḥ ||
indra jaṭharaṃ pṛṇasva madhor asya sutasya | upa tvā madeṣu vājo astu ||
indras turāṣāḍ jaghāna vṛtraṃ sāsāha śatrūn samatsu vajrī | made somasya ||
śrudhī havaṃ me giro juṣasva- -indra svayugbhiḥ matsva madāya | mahe raṇāya ||
ud itye akraman trayo vyāghraḥ puruṣo vṛkaḥ | hirug jyotiḥ sūryo hirug devo vanaspatir hiruṅ navantu śatravaḥ ||
parameṇa pathā vṛkaḥ pareṇa steno arṣatu | tato vyāghraḥ paramaḥ ||
akṣyau ca te hanū ca te vyāghra jambhayāmasi | āt sarvān viṃśatiṃ nakhān ||
yat saṃnaśo vi yan naśo yad ?vinaśo na saṃ naśaḥ? | mūrṇā mṛgasya dantā apiśīrṇā u pṛṣṭayaḥ ||
vyāghraṃ datvatāṃ vayaṃ prathamaṃ jambhayāmasi | ād it stenam ahiṃ yātudhānam atho vṛkam ||
neva rapsasai na gṛhaḥ paraś cara | dvipāc catuṣpān no mā hiṃsīr indrajāḥ somajā asi ||
iyaṃ vīrun madhujātā madhune tvā khanāmasi | madhor adhi prajātāsi sā no madhumatas kṛdhi ||
jihvāyā agre me madhu jihvāmūle madhūlakam | yathā māṃ kāminy aso yathā mām anv āyasi ||
pari tvā paritatnunā- -ikṣuṇāgām avidviṣe | yathā na vidviṣāvahai na vibhavāva kadā cana ||
rājñe brūhi varuṇāya- -aśvāya puruṣāya ca | pathā me pathye revati jāyām ā vaha sādhunā ||
jāyāṃ me mitrāvaruṇā jāyāṃ devī sarasvatī | jāyāṃ me aśvinobhā- -ā dhattāṃ puṣkarasrajā ||
daśavṛkṣa muñcemam aṃhaso grāhyāś ca | atho enaṃ vanaspate jīvānāṃ lokam un naya ||
yaś cakāra sa niṣ karat sa eva subhiṣaktamaḥ | sa eva tubhyaṃ bheṣajaṃ cakāra bhiṣajāti ca ||
cītiṃ te devā avidan brahmāṇa uta vīrudhaḥ | cītiṃ te 'dyottamām avidan bhūmyām adhi ||
āgād ud agād ayaṃ jīvānāṃ vrātam apy agāt | abhūd u putrāṇāṃ pitā nṛṇāṃ ca bhagavattamaḥ ||
adhītim adhy agād ayam adhi jīvapurā agāt | śataṃ ca yasya vīrudhaḥ sahasram uta bheṣajā ||
dīrghāyutvāya bṛhate raṇāya- -ariṣyanto dakṣamāṇāḥ sadaiva | maṇiṃ viṣkandhadūṣaṇaṃ jaṅgiḍaṃ bibhṛmo vayam ||
jaṅgiḍo jambhād viśarād viṣkandhād abhiśocanāt | maṇiḥ sahasravīryaḥ pari ṇaḥ pātu viśvataḥ ||
ayaṃ viṣkandhaṃ sahate ayaṃ rakṣo 'pa bādhate | ayaṃ no viśvabheṣajo jaṅgiḍaḥ pātv aṃhasaḥ ||
devair dattena maṇinā jaṅgiḍena mayobhuvā | viṣkandhaṃ sarvā rakṣāṃsi vyāyāme sahāmahe ||
śaṇaś ca tvā jaṅgiḍaś ca viṣkandhād adhi muñcatām | araṇyād anya ābhṛtaḥ kṛṣyā anyo rasebhyaḥ ||
eha yantu paśavo ye pareyur vāyur yeṣāṃ sahacāraṃ jujoṣa | tvaṣṭā yeṣāṃ rūpadheyāni veda- -asmin tān goṣṭhe savitā ni yacchāt ||
imaṃ goṣṭhaṃ paśavaḥ saṃ sravantu bṛhaspatir ā nayatu prajānan | sinīvālī nayatv āgram eṣām ājagmuṣo anumatir ni yacchāt ||
saṃ saṃ sravantu paśavaḥ sam aśvā uta pūruṣāḥ | saṃ dhānyasya yā sphātiḥ saṃsrāvyeṇa haviṣā juhomi ||
saṃ siñcāmi gavāṃ kṣīraṃ sam ājyena balaṃ rasam | saṃsiktā asmākaṃ vīrā mayi gāvaś ca gopatau ||
ā harāmi gavāṃ kṣīram āhārṣaṃ dhānyaṃ rasam | āhārṣam asmākaṃ vīrān ā patnīm edam astakam ||
saṃ vaḥ sṛjatv aryamā saṃ pūṣā saṃ bṛhaspatiḥ | sam indro yo dhanaṃjaya iha puṣyata yad vasu ||
ihaiva gāva etana- -iho śakā iva puṣyata | ihaivota pra jāyadhvaṃ mayi saṃjñānam astu vaḥ ||
mayā gāvo gopatyā sacadhvam ayaṃ vo goṣṭha iha poṣayāti | rāyaspoṣeṇa bahulā bhavantīr jīvā jīvantīr upa vaḥ sadema ||
saṃ vo goṣṭhena suṣadā saṃ rayyā saṃ supuṣṭyā | aharjātasya yan nāma tena vaḥ saṃ sṛjāmasi ||
saṃjānānā avihrutā asmin goṣṭhe karīṣiṇīḥ | bibhratīḥ somyaṃ haviḥ svāveśāsa etana ||
udyann ādityaḥ krimīn hantu sūryo nimrocan raśmibhir hantu | ye antaḥ krimayo gavi ||
yo viśvarūpaś caturakṣaḥ krimiḥ sāraṅgo arjunaḥ | hato hatabhrātā krimir hatamātā hatasvasā ||
hato rājā krimīṇām utaiṣāṃ sthapatir hataḥ | hatāso asya veśaso hatāsaḥ pariveśasaḥ ||
pra te śṛṇāmi śṛṅge yābhyāṃ tvaṃ vitudāyasi | atho bhinadmi taṃ kumbhaṃ yasmin te nihitaṃ viṣam ||
atrivat tvā krime hanmi kaṇvavaj jamadagnivat | agastyasya brahmaṇā sarve te krimayo hatāḥ ||
indrasya yā mahī dṛṣat krimer viśvasya tarhaṇī | tayā pinaṣmi saṃ krimīn dṛṣadā khalvām̐ iva ||
dṛṣṭam adṛṣṭam atṛham atho kurūrum atṛham | algaṇḍūn sarvāñ chalūlān krimīn vacasā jambhayāmasi ||
algaṇḍūn hanmi mahatā vadhena dūnā adūnā arasā abhūvan | śiṣṭān aśiṣṭān ni tirāmi vācā yathā krimīṇāṃ nakir ucchiṣātai ||
anvāntriyaṃ śīrṣaṇyam atho pārṣṭeyaṃ krimim | avaskavaṃ vyadvaraṃ krimīn vacasā jambhayāmasi ||
ye krimayaḥ parvateṣu ye vaneṣu ya oṣadhīṣu paśuṣv apsv antaḥ | ye asmākaṃ tanvaṃ sthāma cakrira indras tān hantu mahatā vadhena ||
yā śatrūn prāśaṃjayā sahamānābhibhūr asi | sāmūn pratiprāśo jahy arasān kṛṇv oṣadhe ||
suparṇas tvānv avindat sūkaras tvākhanan nasā | indras tvā cakre bāhvor asurebhya starītave ||
pāṭām indro vy āśnād dhantavā asurebhyaḥ | tayāhaṃ śatrūn sākṣīya- -indraḥ śālāvṛkān iva ||
rudra jalāṣabheṣaja nīlaśikhaṇḍa karmakṛt | praśnaṃ durasyato jahi yo asmām̐ abhidāsati ||
tasya praśnaṃ tvaṃ jahi yo na indrābhidāsati | adhi no brūhi śaktibhiḥ prāśi mām uttaraṃ kṛdhi ||
yathedaṃ bhūmyā adhi vātas tṛṇaṃ mathāyati | evā mathnāmi te mano yathā māṃ kāminy aso yathā mām anv āyasi ||
eyam agan patikāmā janikāmo 'ham āgamam | aśvaḥ kanikradad yathā bhagenāhaṃ sahāgamam ||
saṃ cen nayātho aśvinā kāminā saṃ ca neṣathaḥ | saṃ vāṃ manāṃsy agmata saṃ cakṣūṃṣi sam u vratā ||
yad antaraṃ tad bāhyaṃ yad bāhyaṃ tad antaram | kanyānāṃ viśvarūpāṇāṃ mano gṛbhāyauṣadhe ||
?yāsuparṇāpakṣaṇavā- -ānapakṣaṇavā? | atrā ta ārpitaṃ manaḥ śalya iva kurmalaṃ yathā ||
siṃhe vyāghra uta yā pṛdākau tviṣir agnau brāhmaṇe sūrye yā | indraṃ yā devī subhagā vavardha sā na aitu varcasā saṃvidānā ||
(yā) hastini dvīpini yā hiraṇye tviṣir aśveṣu puruṣeṣu goṣu | (…) ||
(yā) rājanye dundubhāv āyatāyāṃ tviṣiḥ senāyāṃ stanayitnau ghoṣe yā | (…) ||
rathe akṣeṣv ṛṣabhasya vāje parjanye vāte varuṇasya śuṣme | indraṃ yā devī subhagā vavardha (…) ||
yā rudreṣu yā vasuṣv ādityeṣu marutsu yā | tviṣir yā viśveṣu deveṣu sā na aitu varcasā saṃvidānā ||
yadi gādhānāṃ yadi nāvyānāṃ nadīnāṃ pāre nṛpatiḥ sakhā naḥ | viśve devāso abhi rakṣatainaṃ yathā jīvo vidatham āvadāsi ||
yady avāre yadi vā gha pāre yadi dhanvani nṛpatiḥ sakhā naḥ | (…) ||
yadi yatsu yadi dhṛtyāṃ yadi samityāṃ nṛpatiḥ sakhā naḥ | (…) ||
adhas padyantām adhare bhavantu ye naḥ sūriṃ maghavānaṃ pṛtanyān | viśve devāso abhi rakṣatainaṃ yathā jīvo vidatham āvadāsi ||
yama mṛtyo mainaṃ hiṃsīr yam ahaṃ hṛdā manasā jugopa | yo māṃ piparti yam ahaṃ piparmi sa prajāvān maghavān sūrir astu ||
imāṃ nāvam ā rohata- -acchidrāṃ pārayiṣṇvam | narāśaṃsasya yā gṛhe śatāritrā bhagasya ca ||
upa dhuva gulgulunā- -ayakṣmāḥ santv aghnyāḥ | rudrasyeṣvā yātudhānān atho rājño bhavasya ca ||
rudrāv īśāte dvipadāṃ catuṣpadāṃ tayor vayam adhivāke syāma | pakvair vitthaiḥ pratibhūṣanta enau vayaṃ devānāṃ sumatau syāma ||
pratīcī nāma te mātā śatavāro gha te pitā | tato ha jajñiṣe tvam ariṣyanty arundhati ||
mātā nāmāsi mātṛto amṛtasyeva vā asi | arundhati tvaṃ sarvam abhi jīvam adhā idam ||
ā no agne sumatiṃ sambhalo ged imāṃ kumārīṃ saha no bhagena | juṣṭā vareṣu samaneṣu valgur oṣaṃ patyā bhavatu saṃbhageyam ||
iyam agne nārī patiṃ videṣṭa somo hi rājā subhagāṃ kṛṇotu | suvānā putrān mahiṣī bhavāti gatvā patiṃ subhagā vi rājāt ||
somajuṣṭo brahmajuṣṭo aryamṇā saṃbhṛto bhagaḥ | dhātur devasya satyena kṛṇomi pativedanam ||
yathākharo maghavaṃś cārur eṣa priyo mṛgāṇāṃ suṣadā babhūva | eveyaṃ juṣṭā bhagasyāstu saṃpriyā patyāvirādhayantī ||
bhagasya nāvam ā roha pūrṇām anupadasvatīm | tayopa pra yāhi taṃ yaḥ patiḥ pratikāmyaḥ ||
idaṃ hiraṇyaṃ gulgulv ayam aukṣo atho bhagaḥ | ete patibhyas tvām aduḥ pratikāmāya vettave ||
yunakta sīrā vi yugā tanota kṛte kṣetre vapateha bījam | virājaḥ śnuṣṭiḥ sabharā asan no nedīya it sṛṇyaḥ pakvam ā yavam ||
sīrā yuñjanti kavayo yugā vi tanvate pṛthag dhīrā deveṣu sumnayau | anaḍvāhaḥ puruṣā ye kṛṣanti lāṅgalaṃ phālaṃ sam anajmi sphātyā ||
śunaṃ kīnāśo anv etu vāhāñ chunaṃ phālo vinudann etu bhūmim | śunāsīrā haviṣā yo yajātai supippalā oṣadhayaḥ santu tasmai ||
śunaṃ naro lāṅgalenānaḍudbhir bhagaḥ phālaiḥ kṣetrapatir marudbhiḥ | parjanyo bījam irayedaṃ hinotu śunāsīrā kṛṇutaṃ dhānyeha ||
indraḥ sītāṃ ni gṛhṇātu tāṃ pūṣābhi rakṣatu | sā naḥ payasvatī duhām uttarāmuttarāṃ samām ||
ud asthād rathajid gojid aśvajid dhiraṇyajit sūnṛtayā parīvṛtaḥ | ekacakreṇa savitā rathena- -ūrjo bhāgaiḥ pṛthivīm ety āpṛṇan ||
gavāṃ gṛhāṇāṃ rasam oṣadhīnām anujyeṣṭhaṃ varca āyur vikalpya | sa mā hiṃsīḥ pitarau vardhamāno bhadrāc chreyāṃsam abhi lokam ehi ||
yadīdaṃ bhaktaṃ yadi vā vibhaktaṃ kṣetraṃ devānāṃ yadi vā pitṝṇām | yadi sūrya udite yadi vā manuṣyavac chivā no astu pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||
ūrjo vāṃ bhāgo vara ā pṛthivyā devī dvārau brahmaṇā vāṃ dhārayāmi | śivaṃ śagmam avasānaṃ no astu rātaṃ devebhiḥ pitṛbhir manuṣyaiḥ ||
viśvāvasos tvā sadanaṃ kulāyaṃ gandharvāso vedhaso mahyam ūcuḥ | sa mā hiṃsīḥ śevadhiṃ yaṃ ta etaṃ śataṃ himāḥ pari dadmo manuṣyam ||
rudrā utse sadam akṣīyamāṇe devā madanti pitaro manuṣyāḥ | ayaṃ bhāgo bhāgapatiś ca devā urvīr astaryāḥ śaradas tarema ||
yo asmin yakṣmaḥ puruṣe praviṣṭa iṣitaṃ daivyaṃ sahaḥ | agniṣ ṭaṃ ghṛtabodhano apa skandayatv adhi dūram asmat so anyena sam ṛcchatāṃ tam asmai pra suvāmasi ||
yas tvā yakṣmo deveṣita iṣitaḥ pitṛbhiś ca yaḥ | tasmāt tvā viśve devā muñcantu pary aṃhasaḥ | te te yakṣmam apa skandayantv adhi (…) | (…) ||
yat tvam eno anyakṛtaṃ yad ātmakṛtam āritha | tasmāt tvā viśvā bhūtāni muñcantu pary aṃhasaḥ | tāni te yakṣmam apa skandayantv adhi (…) (…) ||
yat tvā sva ādṛśā yad vā cakāra niṣṭyaḥ | tasmāt tvā pṛthivī mātā muñcatu pary aṃhasaḥ | sā te yakṣmam apa skandayatv adhi (…) (…) ||
apaskandena haviṣā yakṣmaṃ te nāśayāmasi | tad agnir āha tad u soma āha bṛhaspatiḥ savitā tad indraḥ | te te yakṣmam apa skandayantv adhi dūram asmat so anyena sam ṛcchatāṃ tam asmai pra suvāmasi ||
agnyagrā indrabalā ādityā ye yudho viduḥ | yudho adhi pratiṣṭhitā hotrā jaitrāya juhvati ||
abhiyuktasya pradhane 'nu yoddhāram icchatām | havīṃṣy agre yudhyatāṃ prati gṛhṇīta juhvatām ||
jetrā rājñā varuṇena jetrā rudreṇa keśinā | bhavena jiṣṇunā jayati parjanyena sahīyasā ||
astrā tāmreṇa bṛhatā- -astrā śarveṇa yudhyatā | gandharveṇa tviṣīmatā rathenāsamayodhinā ||

yadīdaṃ devo diva ājagāma yady antarikṣād yadi pārthivo yaḥ | yadi yajño yajñapateḥ svargas tebhyaḥ sarvebhyo namasā vidhema ||
yam indram āhur varuṇaṃ yam āhur yaṃ mitram āhur yam u somam āhuḥ | yam agnim āhur yam u sūryam āhus tebhyaḥ sarvebhyo namasā vidhema ||
ye śmaśānāni manasā nayanti sūryasya raśmīn anusaṃcaranti | ye devānām ṛtvijo yajñiyānāṃ tebhyaḥ sarvebhyo namasā vidhema ||
ye tandriyā jalpyā prorṇuvanti svapnaṃ durbhūtam abhi ye kiranti | ye devānāṃ dharmadhṛto babhūvus tebhyaḥ sarvebhyo namasā vidhema ||
svabhyasair abhi ye bhāyante ye bhāḥ kṛṇvanti ya u rodayanti | ye vā strīṇāṃ pratirūpā babhūvus tebhyaḥ sarvebhyo namasā vidhema ||
vyāvṛttau patho gāvau vyasyau yugyā uta | vidveṣaṇaṃ kilāsitha yathainau vy adidviṣaḥ ||
vi kilaināv adidviṣaḥ śaśvatībhyaḥ samābhyaḥ | atholmukam iva khādiram agnir vām astv antarā ||
siṃhas te astu cakṣuṣe vyāghraḥ pariṣvañjane | agnir vām astv antarā yathā vāṃ na sahāsati ||
vy adyaud vy atatanad vy āsthat kapaṭv iva | yā oṣadhe prasarpasi vy agnir iva tau daha ||
vi vāṃ yantu hṛdayāni vi cittāni manāṃsi ca | atho yat tanvoḥ saṃgataṃ tad vām astu vidūrakam ||
asti vai vāṃ vidvikam ubhau śayane antarā | viṣvañcau pary ā vartethāṃ yathā vāṃ na sahāsati ||
trayaḥ poṣās trivṛtaḥ śrayantām anaktu pūṣā payasā ghṛtena | annasya bhūmā puruṣasya bhūmā bhūmā paśūnāṃ ta iha śrayantām ||
imam ādityā vasunā sam ukṣata- -imam agne vardhaya vāvṛdhānaḥ | asmin trivṛc chrayatāṃ poṣayiṣṇur imam indra saṃ sṛja vīryeṇa ||
bhūmiṣ ṭvā pātu haritena viśvabhṛd agniḥ pipartv ayasā sajoṣāḥ | vīrudbhis te arjunaṃ saṃvidānaṃ varco dadhātu sumanasyamānam ||
tredhā jātaṃ janmanedaṃ hiraṇyam agner ekaṃ priyatamaṃ babhūva | somasyaikaṃ hiṃsitasya parāpatad apām ekaṃ vedhaso reta āhus tat te hiraṇyaṃ trivṛd astv āyuṣe ||
tryāyuṣaṃ jamadagneḥ kaśyapasya tryāyuṣam | tredhāmṛtasya cakṣaṇaṃ trīṇy āyūṃṣi nas kṛdhi ||
trayaḥ suparṇās trivṛtā yad āyann ekākṣaram abhisaṃbhūya śakrāḥ | praty auhan mṛtyum amṛtena sākam antardadhānā bhuvanāni viśvā ||
divas tvā pātu haritaṃ madhyāt tvā pātv arjunam | bhūmyā ayasmayaṃ pātu prāgād devapurā ayam ||
imās tisro devapurās tās tvā rakṣantu sarvataḥ | tās tvaṃ bibhrad āyuṣmān varcasvān uttaro dviṣato bhava ||
puraṃ devānām amṛtaṃ hiraṇyaṃ ya ābedhe prathamo devo agre | tasmai namo daśa prācīḥ kṛṇomy anu manyatāṃ trivṛtā vadhena ||
nava prāṇān navabhiḥ saṃ mimīte dīrghāyutvāya śataśāradāya | harite trīṇi rajate trīṇy ayasi trīṇi tapasāviṣṭitāni ||
ā te cṛtatv aryamā- -ā pūṣā bṛhaspatiḥ | aharjātasya yan nāma tena te 'ti cṛtāmasi ||
ṛtubhiṣ ṭvārtavair ity ekā ||
yajñaṃ yantaṃ tapasā bṛhantam anv ā rohāmi manasā sayoniḥ | upahūtā agne jarasaḥ parastāt tṛtīye nāke sadhamādaṃ madema ||
taṃ prajānan prati gṛhṇātu vidvān prajāpatiḥ prathamajā ṛtasya | asmābhir dattaṃ jarasaḥ parastād acchinnaṃ tantum anu saṃ carema ||
śyenaḥ suparṇo divyo nṛcakṣāḥ sahasrapāc chatayonir vayodhāḥ | sa no ni yaṃsad vasu yat parābhṛtam asmākam astu pitṛṣu svadhāvat ||
etaṃ sadhasthāḥ pari vo dadāmi yam āvahāc chevadhiṃ jātavedāḥ | anvāgantā yajamānaḥ svasti taṃ sma jānīta parame vyoman ||
jānīta smainaṃ parame vyoman devāḥ sadhasthā vida lokam etam | iṣṭāpūrtam anu saṃ krāma vidvān yatra te dattaṃ bahudhā vibandhuṣu ||
yebhiḥ pāśair abhidadhāsi druhvaṇaḥ samāmino anṛtaṃ ye samāmire | tāṃs te vi ṣyāmy āyuṣe balāya- -anamīvaṃ pitum addhi prasūtaḥ ||
anāgā babhro ayam astu vīro druhaḥ pāśebhyaḥ pari pāhy enam | rājan pravidvān pra mumugdhi pāśān yasmai carāmi haviṣā ghṛtena ||
kaśyapa indrāya haviṣā cacāra haritvatīṣu maghavā maghone | paspāra viśvā bhuvanasya gopā antarikṣasya mahato vimāne ||
apūpaṃ nābhilaṃ te ghṛtaścutaṃ nadīnāṃ pade suśrutaṃ juhomi | pravidvān rājan pra mumugdhi pāśān anyasya patnī vidhavā yathāsat ||
anātureṇa varuṇaḥ pathemaṃ svastibhir ati durgāṇi neṣat | tam aśvinā pratigṛhyā svastaye doṣā enam uṣase saṃ pra yacchāt ||
ye piśācā imāṃ vittim ākūtiṃ mohayanti naḥ | teṣāṃ tvam agne nāśaya varcaś cittam atho prajām ||
nāśayāgne piśācānāṃ varcaś cittam atho prajām | athāśāṃ mahyaṃ rādhaya yathāhaṃ kāmaye tathā ||
āśāṃ mahyaṃ rādhayitvā- -indriyeṇa yathāmṛtām | tvam agne kravyādaḥ sarvān piśācām̐ arciṣā daha ||
prati daha yātudhānān mūradevān vicarṣaṇe | ye no durasyā dveṣeṇa- -athāśāṃ mohayanti naḥ ||
ye naḥ paśuṣu dipsanty āśāyāṃ puruṣeṣu ca | tāṃs tvaṃ sahasrākṣeśānaḥ piśācām̐ arciṣā daha ||
sahasvedaṃ sahamāne atho devi sarasvati | athedam aśvinā lakṣma rohitaṃ kṛṇutaṃ yuvam ||
āsurasya mukhasyāgne lakṣmamukhaṃ nāmāsi | meto jyāyo bhūr ita it kanīyo 'so naśyetaḥ paro mā tvā hiṃsiṣam ||
yāsāṃ pitā parjanyo bhūmir mātā babhūva | hvayāmi sarvā oṣadhīr gojātāḥ somajinvatāḥ ||
idaṃ saptaprakhe tvaṃ kilāsaṃ nāśayā tvacaḥ | niṣkṛtir nāma vā asi sedaṃ niṣ kṛdhi bhadrayā ||
niṣkṛtir nāma te mātā niṣkṛtir nāma te pitā | uto tvam asi niṣkṛtiḥ sedaṃ niṣ kṛdhi bhadrayā ||
aurdhvanabhasaḥ prathamaḥ sūryacetā uśadbhyaḥ | cakāra kṛtyām āsuraḥ sā no bhavatu bhadrayā ||
ya imāṃ kṛtyām upajahrur ye vā cakamire ?kṣitam | devānāṃ sarveṣāṃ svasā tān devī nirṛtir hanat ||
kaśyapasya pratisaro dyauṣ pitā pṛthivī mātā | yathābhicakra devās tathāpi kṛṇutā punaḥ ||
yāḥ kṛtyā nīlavatīr yāḥ kṛtyāḥ pāśyāvatīḥ | kṛtyā yāś cakrur lohinīs tā ito nāśayāmasi ||
yadi vā idam ājahrur ime bhadrā asann iti | kṛtyāsi kalyāṇy asi sāmuṃ kartāram anv ihi ||

bṛhat te varcaḥ prathatām upa dyāṃ mitrebhya edhi surabhiḥ suvarcāḥ | adhi te rājā varuṇo bravītu tasmā u tvaṃ haviṣā bhāgadhā asaḥ | śataṃ hemantān damayā sapatnān viśas tvā sarvā anu guṅgavo bhavantu ||
yas tvotpipānaṃ pratyutpipāti yas tvā sajāto viriphāty antitaḥ | indras taṃ yoktre adhame yunaktu tasmai (…) ||
yas tvā yacchantaṃ pratiyaṃyamīti yas tvā jigīṣāt pṛtanāḥ samarye | bṛhaspatis tam ava jaṅghanītu tasmai (…) ||
ye te śulkam āharān ya u te baliṃ somaḥ sajātān upa saṃ namāti te | agniḥ sayugvān adhi te bravītu tasmai (…) ||

variṣṭhaidhi puruḥ prajayā suvīro abhi pra yuṅkṣva damayā sapatnān | indro marutvān adhi te bravītu tasmā u tvaṃ haviṣā bhāgadhā asaḥ | śataṃ hemantān damayā sapatnān viśas tvā sarvā anu guṅgavo bhavantu ||
bhagāya rājñe prathamaṃ juhomi viśve devā uttare mādayantām | uśan patnībhya uśatībhya ābhyaḥ patim agna ā vaha rātahavyaḥ ||
patiṃ vṛṇīṣva haviṣā gṛṇānā tam ā vahāt savitā taṃ te agniḥ | tasmai namasva śataśāradāya bhagabhaktā bhagavatī suvīrā ||
yam aryaman patim asyai dideśitha jane cit santaṃ tam ihā vahāsi | sumaṅgaly apatighnī suśevā rāyaspoṣeṇa tam iṣā sacasva ||
yaṃ te patim aryamā jāyamānāyai dhātā cakalpa tam ihā vahāsi | abhivareṇa haviṣā juhomi prajānann aitu sumanasyamānaḥ ||
patiṃ te dyāvāpṛthivī adhātāṃ patiṃ mitrāvaruṇā vāto agniḥ | sapta rṣayo 'ditiḥ soma indras te tvā devāḥ pativatnīṃ kṛṇvantu ||
yas tvārāyaḥ praviveśa- -ajānir janivām̐ uta | atho yas tanvaṃ pasparśa tam ito nir ṇayāmasi ||
niṣ ṭvārāya nayāmasi ya imāṃ praviveśitha | ātmānam asyā mā hiṃsīr anyatra cara meha bhūḥ ||
yad arāyemām upāyasi dhehy asyai rayipoṣaṇam | prajāṃ cid asyā mā hiṃsīr anyatra cara meha bhūḥ ||
yad arāyehāyasi hanāma vīrudhā tvā | atho khanitrimais tvā- -ād vṛṣeṇa yathābhagam ||
yad arāyāsūyaṃ straiṣūyam āvatokyam | yat paitṛṣadyaṃ daurbhāgyaṃ tad ito nir ṇayāmasi ||
yat te sūrya divi deveṣu varcas tasya no dhehi tvam asi pracetāḥ | ahaṃ tvad ugras tviṣitas tviṣīmān imāṃ vācaṃ vi sākṣīya ||
vātaḥ purastāt pavase nabhasvān | namas te vidma te nāmadheyaṃ mā no hiṃsīḥ ||
tapojā amūro dakṣiṇataḥ pavase nabhasvān | namas te vidma te nāmadheyaṃ mā no hiṃsīḥ ||
viśvāyur viśvajanīnaḥ pratīcyā diśaḥ pavase nabhasvān | namas te vidma te nāmadheyaṃ mā no hiṃsīḥ ||
śivo vaiśvadeva udīcyā diśaḥ pavase nabhasvān | namas te vidma te nāmadheyaṃ mā no hiṃsīḥ ||
atiṣṭhāvān bārhaspatya ūrdhvāyā diśaḥ pavase nabhasvān | namas te vidma te nāmadheyaṃ mā no hiṃsīḥ ||
apādyaud apātatanad apaskandya vadhed ahim | kalyāṇyā yathā smitaṃ śam u naḥ santu vidyutaḥ ||
yat parjanya stanayati sarvaṃ saṃvijate jagat | patiṃ tad ṛtviyāvatī pṛthivī prati modate ||
eṣa enā abhy akrandīd vṛṣāśvo dhenukā iva | ahīṃs tvaṃ vidyutā jahi māsmākaṃ puruṣān vadhīḥ ||
abhikrandāt stanayitnor avasphūrjād aśanyā uta | devā maruto mṛḍata naḥ pātu no duritād avadyāt ||
ṛjīte pari ṇo nama- -ādityāḥ śarma yacchata | yuyuta parṇinaṃ śaram utāparṇaṃ riśādasaḥ ||
kṛtavyadhani vidhya taṃ yaś cakāra tam ij jahi | na tvām acakruṣe vayaṃ vadhāya saṃ śiśīmahe ||
yathā te devy oṣadhe pratīcīnaṃ phalaṃ kṛtam | evā tvaṃ kṛtvane kṛtyāṃ hastagṛhya parā ṇaya ||
punaḥ kṛtyāṃ kṛtyākṛte godhevāvaṭam anv ayat | saktur iva saktupreṣyaṃ pratīcī prati dadhvasat ||
yāṃ te cakrur vartaneṣu vārtākuṣu vṛtāsu ca | maṇḍūke kṛtyāṃ yāṃ cakrus tayā kṛtyākṛto jahi ||
agnir ivaitu pratikūlam anukūlam ivodakam | sukhe ratha iva vartatāṃ kṛtyā kṛtyākṛtaṃ kṛtā ||
agnir dyumnena sūryo jyotiṣā dyaur mahimnāntarikṣaṃ vyacasā | diśa āśābhiḥ pṛthivī payobhir idaṃ rāṣṭraṃ vardhayantu prajāvat ||
tvaṣṭā rūpeṇa savitā savena- -ahar mitreṇa varuṇena rātrī | pūṣā puṣṭair bhago aṃśena bhaktyā- -idaṃ rāṣṭraṃ vardhayantu prajāvat ||
yāṃ viśvakarmā nijaghāna methim antarā dyāvāpṛthivī ubhe | tasyā āhuḥ kṣatriyaṃ garbham etaṃ pari māva patthā mūrdhani dhārayasva ||
chandāṃsy asyā abhito mayūkhā stomā ātmā yajur asyāḥ purīṣam | tasyā āhuḥ kṣatriyaṃ nirmitaṃ pari māva patthā mūrdhani dhārayasva ||
parā ṇudasva vyathayābhimātim adhaspadaṃ kṛṇuṣva durdharāyataḥ | mā tvā dabhan sapatnā dipsantas tava rāṣṭram uttamaṃ dyumnam astu ||
idaṃ tan mitrāvaruṇā havir vāṃ yenāgre devā amṛtatvam āyan | tenāsmai kṣatram adhi dhārayaujo 'sapatnāḥ pradiśaḥ santv asmai ||
ghṛtasya dhārā mitrāvaruṇā duhāṃ vāṃ dhenur anapasphurantī | devaḥ savitota vāyur agnir bhūtasya patir iha śarma yacchāt ||
śaṃ nas tan mitrāvaruṇā gṛṇītaṃ tṛḍhā amitrā bahudhā vi śerām | jayatu senopa ghoṣa etu pṛthak satvāno bahudhā bharantām ||
hanāma mitrāvaruṇāv amitrān bhavāma bhadre sukṛtasya loke | pārayān naḥ savitā devo agnir jayāmedaṃ haviṣā kaśyapasya ||
vāto yaṃ mitrāvaruṇā tad āha viśvantaraṃ nirmitaṃ kaśyapasya | adhvaryavo maruto yasyāsan tena devebhyo varimāṇi cakruḥ ||
acikradat svapā iha bhavad agne yajasva rodasī urūcī | āmuṃ naya namasā rātahavyo yuñjantu suprajasaṃ pañca janāḥ ||
dūre cit santam aruṣāsa indram ā cyāvayantu sakhyāya vipram | yad gāyatrīṃ bṛhatīm arkam asmai sautrāmaṇyādadhṛṣan ?tu devāḥ ||
adbhyas tvā rājā varuṇo juhāva somas tvāyaṃ hvayatu parvatebhyaḥ | indras tvāyaṃ hvayatu viḍbhya ābhyaḥ śyeno bhūtvā viśa ā patemāḥ ||
śyenaṃ havir nayatv ā parasmād anyakṣetre aparuddhaṃ carantam | aśvinā panthāṃ kṛṇutāṃ sugaṃ te garbhaṃ sajātā abhi saṃ viśadhvam ||
śyenaṃ haviḥ kaśyapasyopa śikṣa- -indraṃ vātaḥ prahito dūta ā vaha | viṣahya śatrūn senāgrair viśo vṛṇāno 'va gaccha kāmī ||
yas te havaṃ paritiṣṭhāt sajāta uta niṣṭiyaḥ | apāca indra tān nītvā- -athemam ava gamaya ||
hvayantu tvā pañca janāḥ patiṃ mitrā avṛṣata | indrāgnī viśve devā viśi kṣemam adīdharan ||
prajāpatir anavartiḥ sa prajābhir anavartiḥ | sa mānavartir anavartiṃ kṛṇotu ||
indro 'navartiḥ sa vīryeṇānavartiḥ | (…) ||
somo 'navartiḥ sa oṣadhībhir anavartiḥ | sa mānavartir anavartiṃ kṛṇotu ||
āpo 'navartayas tāḥ parjanyenānavartayaḥ | tā mānavartayo 'navartiṃ kṛṇvantu ||
devā anavartayas te 'mṛtenānavartayaḥ | te mānavartayo 'navartiṃ kṛṇvantu ||
payo mahyam oṣadhayaḥ payo me vīrudho dadhan | apāṃ payasvad yat payas tan me varṣantu vṛṣṭayaḥ ||
payo mahyaṃ payasvanto hastino me payo dadhan | payaḥ patatriṇo mahyam aiṇeyā me payo dadhan ||
payasvan me kṣetram astu payasvad uta dhānyam | ahaṃ payasvān bhūyāsaṃ gāvo ma uta payasvatīḥ ||
payo mahyam apsaraso gandharvā me payo dadhan | payo me viśvā bhūtāni vāto dadhātu me payaḥ ||
payo mahyaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī antarikṣaṃ payo dadhat | payo ma indraś cāgniś ca dhātā dadhātu me payaḥ ||
ahaṃ bibharmi te mano ahaṃ cittam ahaṃ vratam | mamed api kratāv aso mama citte sacāvahai ||
āmanā asa ihamanā asa iha te ramatāṃ manaḥ | mayi te ramatāṃ manaḥ ||
āñjanasya madhughasya kuṣṭhasya naladasya ca | vīrodekasya mūlena mukhe nimandanaṃ kṛtam ||
madhu me antar āsye mukhe nimandanaṃ kṛtam | tatro tvaṃ vi vartasva narācīva vartasi ||
yathā nemī rathacakraṃ samantaṃ pariṣasvaje | evā pari ṣvajasva mā yathāsan mayi te manaḥ ||
yathedam aśvinā tṛṇaṃ vāto vahati bhūmyāḥ | evā vayaṃ vahāmasi yāṃ vayaṃ kāmayāmahe ||
ut tvā mātā sthāpayatu pra tvā nudatām aśvinā | adhā śiśur iva mātaraṃ mām evānv etu te manaḥ ||
yathā kṣīraṃ ca sarpiś ca manuṣyāṇāṃ hṛdaḥ priyam | evāham asyā nāryā hṛdo bhūyāsam uttaraḥ ||
agneṣ ṭvā tapas tapatu vātasya dhrājiḥ | mā spṛkṣathā niṣadanāya sādhava ut tiṣṭha prehy agnivat te kṛṇomi ||
sūryasya tvā tapas tapatu vātasya dhrājiḥ | mā spṛkṣathā niṣadanāya sādhava ut tiṣṭha prehi sūryavat te kṛṇomi ||
hiraṇyapuṣpī subhagā kūpaś cāyaṃ sumaṅgalaḥ | tāv enāṃ bhadrayā dhattām amṛtāv amṛte bhage ||
hiraṇyaṃ pṛḍvad dharitaṃ tat te aṅgeṣu rohatu | tenemām aśvinā nārīṃ bhagenābhi ṣiñcatam ||
yathā kūpam udahṛtas tṛṣyanto yanti kāminaḥ | evā tvā sarve devaraḥ patayo yantu kāminaḥ ||
hiraṇyākṣi madhuvarṇe hiraṇyaparicartane | aṅko hiraṇyayas tava tenāsyai patim ā vaha ||
yadi vāsi tiro janaṃ yadi vā nadyas tiraḥ | iyaṃ tvā mahyam oṣadhir aṅkeneva ny ā nayāt ||
punaḥ prāṇaṃ punar apānam asmai punar vyānam uta soma dhehi | ātmāyaṃ cakṣur ?udate samānas tam ū nu pāhi tam ū nu jinva jāgṛhi ||
tvaṣṭā rūpeṇa savitā savena- -ahar mitreṇa varuṇena rātrī | indro jyaiṣṭhyena brahmaṇāyaṃ bṛhaspatiḥ pūṣāsmai punar asuṃ dadhātu ||
ya ādityā vasavo ye ca rudrā viśve devā aditir yā ca rātrī | yajño bhagaḥ savitā ye ca devā yamo 'smai punar asuṃ dadhātu ||
punas te rājā varuṇo dadātu somo rājāsum it te punar dāt | indro marudbhir aśvinā te bhiṣajyatām agnī rudro 'sum it te punar dāt ||
punar dyaur devī punar antarikṣam agnir vātaḥ pavamāno bhiṣajyatu | grāhyāḥ pāśān nirṛtyāḥ pāśān mṛtyoḥ pāśād vāk tvā devī punar dadātu ||
idaṃ cakṣur ṛtāvarī mā mā hāsīt purāyuṣaḥ | yad vāṃ tamo yad ripiśam apa vāṃ tan ni dadhmasi ||
yad andhiyaṃ yad algaṇaṃ yo 'rmo adhirohati | ayasmayas tad aṅkuśo akṣṇo 'rmam apa lumpatu ||

yathā cakṣuḥ suparṇasya yathāśvasya yathā śunaḥ | evā me aśvinā cakṣuḥ kṛṇutaṃ puṣkarasrajā ||
yasyāḥ suparṇaḥ prapatañ cakṣuṣā cakṣur ādade | tasyāḥ samudraje tava cakṣuṣā cakṣur ā dade ||

vi rakṣo vi mṛdho jahi vi vṛtrasya hanū ruja | vi manyum indra vṛtrahann amitrasyābhidāsataḥ ||
vi na indra vi mṛdho jahi nīcā yaccha pṛtanyataḥ | adhamaṃ gamayā tamo yo asmām̐ abhidāsati ||
svastidā viśāṃ patir vṛtrahā vimṛdho vaśī | vṛṣendraḥ pura etu naḥ somapā abhayaṃkaraḥ ||
apendra dviṣato mano 'pa jijyāsato vadham | vi mahac charma yaccha varīyo yāvayā vadham ||
ayaṃ yo 'titaro maṇis tenāti tara duśyasaḥ | sapatnān dviṣato maṇe pra ṇudasva pṛtanyataḥ ||
pra ṇudasva pra sahasva sapatnān dviṣato maṇe | tarābhimātiṃ duśyasāṃ varco bhaṅgdhi pṛtanyatām ||
varco jahi manyuṃ jahy ākūtiṃ dviṣatāṃ maṇe | devo yo 'titaro maṇis tenāti tara dhūrvataḥ ||
ye dhūrvanti ye druhyanti ye dviṣanti pṛtanyataḥ | sarvān sapatnāṃs te maṇir ni manyuṃ dviṣatas karat ||
tava citte tava vrate tavaivādhaspadaṃ carān | devo yo 'titaro maṇis tenāti tara duśyasaḥ ||
